paths_note: band_root is machine-specific and deliberately empty here. Copy this file to configs/crop_band_config.json (gitignored) and set it to an area-band output folder - either a single subject folder or the parent holding many.
bbox_note: bbox values are per-dataset: they are fractions of the rendered image, and the atlas slices are not the same size or aspect as the fetal_surface ones (221x180 axial, 180x180 coronal, 180x221 sagittal). Re-pick them per dataset rather than reusing another dataset's numbers. null means the axis is skipped unless allow_auto_for_unset_axes is true.
